About:

Join Mindy as she demonstrates exactly how to ship your first product to the Amazon FBA warehouse in under 5 minutes. Mindy uses a real-world example to guide you through the process step-by-step.

- Logging into Amazon Seller Central and setting up your Send to Amazon workflow correctly using the Send/Replenish Inventory feature.
- Creating a case pack template while adhering to strict Amazon warehouse requirements for box weight and dimensions.
- Managing ship from addresses, including how to handle direct shipments from manufacturers in China to the US.
- Understanding the difference between Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) with UPS versus Less Than a Truckload (LTL) for pallet shipments.

- Instructions for confirming shipping charges, printing Box ID labels, and tracking your inventory status after drop-off.

This tutorial from Mindy covers everything you need to know about logistics, labeling, and the seller dashboard so you can successfully get your stock into fulfillment centers without making costly beginner mistakes or having your shipment rejected.
